description: Reconstruction rules applied by :reconstruct and :orchestrator in V0. Each application is recorded per method in recovery/report.json (ruleIds) and per source line in recovery/source-map.json. No rule grants acceptance: every candidate is validated after rules are applied.

rules.precondition: block ends in a conditional branch; acyclic CFG
rules.transformation: if/else closed at the immediate post-dominator
one local per phi, assigned on each incoming edge

rules.precondition: block with several predecessors that is not a structured join
rules.transformation: block emitted per path with phis replaced by the edge value
negated condition, fall-through arm first (javac layout)
rules.check: equivalence.bv32; structural match is fidelity evidence

rules.precondition: conditional branch selected by a probe
single phi local assigned in both arms only
int t = E; return t; and t unused elsewhere
div/rem whose only use is not in the same block, or unused
rules.transformation: local variable at the definition so the exception stays on the same paths

rules.precondition: x + n with literal n < 0 and n != MIN_VALUE

rules.check: equivalence.bv32; structural match is fidelity evidence

rules.precondition: debug info names every parameter with a legal, unique Java identifier

rules.transformation: deterministic p0, p1, ...; locals t0, t1, ...

rules.precondition: public-or-package <init>()V that only calls Object.<init>() on this
accepted candidate does not recompile to identical bytecode
rules.transformation: greedy probes over polarity, operand order and ternary form
rules.check: variant revalidated before it replaces the accepted candidate
